# `glmap`

**High-Performance GPU Geospatial Mapping for R (`sf`, `terra`, `wk`,
`nanoarrow`, `DuckDB`, `Shiny`, `Quarto`)**

`glmap` is a compact, next-generation WebGL2 + **MapLibre GL**
interactive mapping package for R built to replace `leaflet` for modern
geospatial workflows (`sf`, `terra`, `wk`, `nanoarrow`, `shiny`, and
`crosstalk`).

Where `leaflet` serializes R objects into huge GeoJSON text strings
inside HTML and renders them on the CPU/DOM (choking at 50k–100k
features), `glmap` packs coordinates, C++17 `mapbox/earcut`-triangulated
polygon meshes (with full interior hole support), and raw `Float32`
raster bands into compact binary packets (`GEXP` and `GEXR`) that map
directly into WebGL2 GPU vertex buffers and floating-point textures.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 1. Performance & Architecture Comparison: `glmap` vs. `leaflet`

| Dimension | `leaflet` (R Package) | `glmap` (C++17 + WebGL2 + MapLibre GL) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Rendering Engine** | Leaflet.js (2D DOM / SVG / Canvas) | **MapLibre GL JS** + **Custom WebGL2 Shaders** (60 FPS GPU) |
| **R-to-Browser Data Transfer** | GeoJSON text embedded in HTML (`jsonlite`) | **Zero-JSON `GEXP` / `GEXR` Binary Buffers** (`zlib` stream or `httpuv` Range server) |
| **1,000,000 Points** | ~18–45 sec R serialization, \>180 MB HTML, tab crash | **0.05 sec** in C++17 (19.07 MB raw / ~5 MB compressed), 60 FPS |
| **Polygon Triangulation** | Single-threaded JS `earcut` on browser main thread | **Pre-triangulated in C++17 (`mapbox/earcut.hpp`)** before reaching browser |
| **1,000,000 Point Hexbinning** | Requires external R pre-aggregation ([`sf::st_make_grid`](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/reference/st_make_grid.html)) | **0.10 sec** native C++17 64-bit spatial hash ([`add_hexbin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_hexbin.md)) |
| **[`terra::SpatRaster`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatRaster-class.html) Rendering** | Re-projects & encodes static PNG in R on every change | **Raw `Float32` GPU Texture (`RGBA32F`)**: **0 ms** live colormap, hillshade, & band math |
| **Hover Pixel Inspection** | Not natively supported on rasters without server roundtrip | **O(1) in-memory `Float32Array` readout** at cursor (`Lon/Lat` + exact cell value) |
| **Out-of-Core / 10M+ Features** | Not supported | **Native `DuckDB` / Parquet SQL Pushdown ([`add_duckdb()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_duckdb.md))** + **C++17 R-Tree Index** |
| **Color Mapping** | Manual [`colorNumeric()`](https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/reference/colorNumeric.html) / [`colorFactor()`](https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/reference/colorNumeric.html) boilerplate | **Direct `~column` formula or string** with 256-entry C/R LUT & automatic legend |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 2. Quick Start (Onboarding in 60 Seconds)

### One-Liner Auto-Detection

Pass any `sf`, `sfc`,
[`terra::SpatRaster`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatRaster-class.html),
[`terra::SpatVector`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatVector-class.html),
[`wk::xy`](https://paleolimbot.github.io/wk/reference/xy.html),
`nanoarrow_array`, `stars`, `data.frame`, or
[`crosstalk::SharedData`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/crosstalk/man/SharedData.html)
directly to
[`glmap()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap.md):

``` r

library(glmap)

# Generate synthetic benchmark data (200k points, 3k polygons, 250x250 Float32 DEM)
bench <- gl_benchmark_data(n_points = 200000L, n_polygons = 3000L)

# Instant one-line GPU map (auto-detects geometry or raster type)
glmap(bench$polygons_sf, fill_color = ~elevation, palette = "viridis")
```

### Multi-Layer Pipeable Workflow (`|>`)

``` r

glmap(basemap = "dark") |>
  add_raster(
    bench$raster_mat,
    palette = "terrain",
    hillshade = TRUE,
    opacity = 0.65,
    group = "GPU Terrain DEM (Float32)"
  ) |>
  add_polygons(
    bench$polygons_sf,
    fill_color = ~elevation,
    palette = "viridis",
    fill_opacity = 0.65,
    group = "C++ Earcut Polygons (3k)"
  ) |>
  add_hexbin(
    bench$points_df,
    hex_radius = 0.035,
    palette = "plasma",
    opacity = 0.75,
    group = "C++ Hexbin Aggregation"
  ) |>
  add_points(
    bench$points_df,
    color = ~intensity,
    palette = "turbo",
    radius = 3.0,
    opacity = 0.85,
    group = "GPU Instanced Points (200k)"
  ) |>
  use_plugin("export_png")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 3. Transitioning from `leaflet` to `gexplore` (Human & Agent Cheat Sheet)

### Side-by-Side Translation Table

| Task | `leaflet` Code | `gexplore` Equivalent |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Initialize Map** | `leaflet(data) |> addProviderTiles("CartoDB.DarkMatter")` | `gexplore(data, basemap = "dark")` |
| **Basemap Switch** | `addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron")` | `set_basemap("positron")` (`"dark"`, `"voyager"`, `"osm"`, `"satellite"`) |
| **Add Points** | `addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, color = ~pal(val), radius = 5)` | `add_points(lon = ~lon, lat = ~lat, color = ~val, palette = "viridis", radius = 5)` |
| **Add Lines** | `addPolylines(color = "#38bdf8", weight = 2)` | `add_lines(color = "#38bdf8", width = 2)` |
| **Add Polygons** | `addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal(elev), fillOpacity = 0.7, weight = 1)` | `add_polygons(fill_color = ~elev, palette = "viridis", fill_opacity = 0.7, line_width = 1)` |
| **Add Raster (`terra`)** | `addRasterImage(r, colors = "terrain")` | `add_raster(r, palette = "terrain", hillshade = TRUE)` |
| **Add Legend** | `addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~val, title = "Val")` | **Automatic!** (Or customize via [`add_legend()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_legend.md)) |
| **Set Camera View** | `setView(lng = -73.56, lat = 45.50, zoom = 10)` | `set_view(lng = -73.56, lat = 45.50, zoom = 10, pitch = 0)` |
| **Fit Bounding Box** | `fitBounds(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)` | `fit_bounds(c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax))` (or pass `sf` / `SpatRaster` directly) |
| **Shiny UI / Server** | `leafletOutput("map")` / `renderLeaflet({...})` | `gexploreOutput("map")` / `renderGexplore({...})` |
| **Shiny Live Proxy** | `leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("pts")` | `gexplore_proxy("map") |> clear_layer("pts")` |
| **Out-of-Core DuckDB / Parquet** | *(Not available)* | `add_duckdb(con, "sensors.parquet", color = ~val, where = "val > 50")` |
| **Save Standalone HTML** | `htmlwidgets::saveWidget(m, "map.html")` | `gx_save_html(m, "map.html")` |

### Before & After Code Comparison

**Before (`leaflet` — verbose palette setup, slow on \>50k rows):**

``` r

library(leaflet)

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "viridis", domain = df$intensity)

leaflet(df) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.DarkMatter) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal(intensity),
    radius = 4,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = FALSE
  ) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~intensity, title = "Intensity")
```

**After (`gexplore` — concise, automatic legend, 100x faster C++ binary
-\> WebGL2):**

``` r

library(gexplore)

gexplore(df, basemap = "dark") |>
  add_points(color = ~intensity, palette = "viridis", radius = 4, opacity = 0.8, stroke = FALSE)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Shiny Integration & Zero-Copy Proxy Updates

In Shiny applications,
[`gexplore_proxy()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap_proxy.md)
updates existing GPU layers in-place without re-creating the basemap or
re-uploading unchanged buffers:

``` r

library(shiny)
library(gexplore)

bench <- gx_benchmark_data(n_points = 100000L)

ui <- fluidPage(
  selectInput("pal", "Raster GPU Palette:", choices = c("terrain", "viridis", "magma", "turbo", "rdylbu")),
  checkboxInput("hill", "GPU Hillshade", value = TRUE),
  gexploreOutput("map", height = "650px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$map <- renderGexplore({
    gexplore(basemap = "dark") |>
      add_raster(bench$raster_mat, id = "dem", palette = "terrain", hillshade = TRUE) |>
      add_points(bench$points_df, id = "pts", color = ~intensity, palette = "plasma")
  })

  # 0ms GPU uniform update — does NOT re-send raster data!
  observeEvent(list(input$pal, input$hill), {
    gexplore_proxy("map") |>
      set_raster_style("dem", palette = input$pal, hillshade = input$hill)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # React to map clicks, viewport bounds, and box-brush selections
  observeEvent(input$map_click, {
    message("Clicked at: ", input$map_click$lng, ", ", input$map_click$lat,
            " | Raster value: ", input$map_click$raster_value)
  })

  observeEvent(input$map_selected, {
    message("Brushed ", input$map_selected$count, " features!")
  })
}
```

### Shiny Input Events Emitted Automatically by `gexplore`

For a widget with `outputId = "map"`, `gexplore` automatically
provides: - `input$map_click`: `list(lng, lat, raster_value)` on map
click. - `input$map_bounds`: `list(west, south, east, north)` after
every pan/zoom (`moveend`). - `input$map_selected`:
`list(bbox, count, indices)` when the user drags a selection with the
**Box Brush** tool.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 5. Extension & Plugin Ecosystem (`register_plugin()`, Custom Shaders, Deck.gl)

`gexplore` is designed to be extended by third-party packages
(`gexplore.extras`, internal organizational packages, etc.) via three
levels:

1.  **Level 1 — JS/CSS Plugin Registry
    ([`register_plugin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/register_plugin.md)
    &
    [`use_plugin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/use_plugin.md))**:

    ``` r

    register_plugin(
      name = "watermark",
      css = ".gx-wm { position:absolute; top:12px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); color:#38bdf8; z-index:15; font-weight:700; }",
      js_init = "function(instance, config) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'gx-wm';
        div.textContent = config.text || 'CONFIDENTIAL';
        instance.el.appendChild(div);
      }",
      default_config = list(text = "Beneva Geospatial")
    )

    gexplore(bench$points_df) |> use_plugin("watermark", config = list(text = "Live Sensor Feed"))
    ```

    Built-in plugins ready out of the box: `"measure"`,
    `"lasso_select"`, `"minimap"`, `"export_png"`.

2.  **Level 2 — Custom WebGL2 GLSL Shaders
    ([`add_webgl_shader_layer()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_webgl_shader_layer.md))**:
    Pass custom vertex and fragment shader GLSL strings directly from R
    while leveraging `gexplore`’s C++17 `GEXP` binary vertex/attribute
    buffers.

3.  **Level 3 — Custom Deck.gl Layer Bridge
    ([`add_deck_layer()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_deck_layer.md))**:
    Dispatch arbitrary `deck.gl` layer specifications backed by binary
    buffers.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 6. Ready-to-Run Examples (Quarto, Shiny & Showcase)

The package ships with three complete, runnable examples in
`inst/examples/`:

1.  **Interactive Multi-Layer GPU Showcase**:

    ``` r

    source(system.file("examples/showcase.R", package = "glmap"))
    ```

2.  **Full Shiny Dashboard App (`glmap_proxy`, 0ms GPU Raster Shader,
    Group Controls & Live Telemetry)**:

    ``` r

    shiny::runApp(system.file("examples/shiny_app", package = "glmap"))
    ```

3.  **Self-Contained Quarto Document (`quarto_report.qmd`)**:

    ``` r

    file.edit(system.file("examples/quarto_report.qmd", package = "glmap"))
    # Render via: quarto render inst/examples/quarto_report.qmd
    ```

4.  **Full Documentation & Benchmarks**:

    - [`vignette("getting-started", package = "glmap")`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/articles/getting-started.md)
    - [`vignette("leaflet-migration", package = "glmap")`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/articles/leaflet-migration.md)
    - [`vignette("benchmarks-and-leaflet-parity", package = "glmap")`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/articles/benchmarks-and-leaflet-parity.md)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 7. Instructions for AI Coding Agents

If you are an AI agent (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) generating or
refactoring R mapping code in this workspace, read
[AGENTS.md](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/AGENTS.md) for deterministic
rules on replacing `leaflet` with `glmap`.

# Package index

## Map Initialization, Camera & Providers

Initialize a GPU map and control camera position, bounds, basemap
providers, API keys, terrain, and projection.

- [`glmap()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap.md)
  [`gexplore()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap.md)
  [`gx_map()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap.md) :

  Create a High-Performance GPU Map Widget (`glmap`)

- [`set_view()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_view.md) :
  Set Map Camera View (Center, Zoom, Pitch, Bearing)

- [`fit_bounds()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/fit_bounds.md)
  :

  Fit Map Camera to a Bounding Box `[xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]`
  (`fit_bounds`)

- [`fly_to()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/fly_to.md) :

  Smoothly Animate Camera to Target Location (`flyTo`)

- [`fly_to_bounds()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/fly_to_bounds.md)
  :

  Smoothly Animate Camera to Bounding Box (`fly_to_bounds`)

- [`set_max_bounds()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_max_bounds.md)
  :

  Restrict Map Panning to Maximum Bounding Box (`set_max_bounds`)

- [`set_basemap()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_basemap.md)
  :

  Change the Map Basemap Style (`set_basemap`)

- [`add_provider_tiles()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_provider_tiles.md)
  :

  Add or Switch Basemap Provider Tiles (`add_provider_tiles`)

- [`gl_providers`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_providers.md)
  :

  Basemap Tile Providers Catalog (`gl_providers`)

- [`gl_list_providers()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_list_providers.md)
  :

  List All Built-in Basemap Tile Providers in `glmap`

- [`gl_set_api_key()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_set_api_key.md)
  [`gl_get_api_key()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_set_api_key.md)
  :

  Set or Retrieve a Provider API Key (`gl_set_api_key` /
  `gl_get_api_key`)

- [`set_terrain()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_terrain.md)
  : Enable 3D Terrain Elevation on the Map

- [`set_projection()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_projection.md)
  :

  Set Map Projection (`"mercator"` or `"globe"`)

- [`add_control()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_control.md)
  : Configure Map UI Controls

- [`add_legend()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_legend.md)
  : Add a Custom Map Legend

- [`gl_save_html()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_save_html.md)
  [`gx_save_html()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_save_html.md)
  :

  Save a `glmap` Map to a Standalone HTML File (`gl_save_html`)

## GPU Vector, Raster & Out-of-Core Layers

Add high-density point clouds, geodesic circles, rectangles, lines,
earcut-triangulated polygons, Float32 rasters, hexbins, heatmaps, WMS,
PMTiles, and DuckDB layers.

- [`add_sf()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_sf.md) :

  Automatically Add an `sf`, `sfc`, or `data.frame` Layer to a
  `gexplore` Map

- [`add_points()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_points.md)
  : Add a GPU Instanced Point Layer (Handles 1M+ Points at 60 FPS)

- [`add_circles()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_circles.md)
  :

  Add a Geodesic Circle Layer (`add_circles`)

- [`add_rectangles()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_rectangles.md)
  :

  Add a Bounding-Box Rectangle Layer (`add_rectangles`)

- [`add_lines()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_lines.md)
  : Add a GPU LineString / MultiLineString Layer

- [`add_polygons()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_polygons.md)
  : Add a Pre-Triangulated GPU Polygon / MultiPolygon Layer

- [`add_raster()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_raster.md)
  :

  Add a GPU Fragment-Shader Raster Layer for
  [`terra::SpatRaster`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatRaster-class.html)

- [`add_hexbin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_hexbin.md)
  : Add a C++ Accelerated Hexagonal Binning Layer for 1M+ Points

- [`add_heatmap()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_heatmap.md)
  : Add a GPU Additive Kernel Density Heatmap Layer

- [`add_labels()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_labels.md)
  :

  Add a GPU Text / Symbol Label Layer (`add_labels`)

- [`add_popups()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_popups.md)
  :

  Add Standalone HTML Popups (`add_popups`)

- [`add_wms_tiles()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_wms_tiles.md)
  :

  Add an OGC Web Map Service (WMS) Raster Tile Layer (`add_wms_tiles`)

- [`add_pmtiles()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_pmtiles.md)
  [`add_mvt()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_pmtiles.md)
  : Add a Cloud-Native PMTiles or Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) Layer

- [`add_geojson()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_geojson.md)
  : Add a Raw GeoJSON URL or Object Layer

- [`add_duckdb()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_duckdb.md)
  :

  Add a Live Out-of-Core DuckDB / Parquet Layer (`add_duckdb`)

## Shiny Proxy, Group Controls & Live GPU Updates

Update layers, groups, visibility, opacity, filters, and GPU raster
shaders in 0ms without re-rendering.

- [`glmapOutput()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmapOutput.md)
  [`gexploreOutput()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmapOutput.md)
  :

  Shiny UI Output for `glmap`

- [`renderGlmap()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/renderGlmap.md)
  [`renderGexplore()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/renderGlmap.md)
  :

  Shiny Server Render Function for `glmap`

- [`glmap_proxy()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap_proxy.md)
  [`gexplore_proxy()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/glmap_proxy.md)
  :

  Create a Shiny Proxy for a `glmap` Map Widget

- [`show_group()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/show_group.md)
  [`hide_group()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/show_group.md)
  [`clear_group()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/show_group.md)
  :

  Show, Hide, or Clear Layers by Group Name (`show_group`, `hide_group`,
  `clear_group`)

- [`clear_layer()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/clear_layer.md)
  : Clear a Single Layer by ID

- [`clear_layers()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/clear_layers.md)
  : Clear All Data Layers from a Map

- [`set_layer_visibility()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_layer_visibility.md)
  : Toggle Layer Visibility

- [`set_layer_opacity()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_layer_opacity.md)
  : Update Layer Opacity Dynamically

- [`set_raster_style()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_raster_style.md)
  : Live-Update a GPU Raster Layer's Colormap, Contrast Range, or
  Hillshading (0ms GPU Update)

- [`set_filter()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/set_filter.md)
  : Filter Visible Features by Index on the GPU

## Plugins, Custom Shaders & Binary Engine

Extend glmap with custom JS plugins, GLSL shaders, C++17 binary packers,
and spatial indices.

- [`register_plugin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/register_plugin.md)
  :

  Register a Reusable `gexplore` Extension Plugin

- [`use_plugin()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/use_plugin.md)
  :

  Attach a Registered or Inline Plugin to a `gexplore` Map

- [`list_plugins()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/list_plugins.md)
  :

  List Available `gexplore` Plugins

- [`add_webgl_shader_layer()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_webgl_shader_layer.md)
  :

  Add a Custom WebGL2 Shader Layer to a `gexplore` Map

- [`add_deck_layer()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/add_deck_layer.md)
  : Add a Custom Deck.gl / External Layer Specification

- [`gl_pack_sf_binary()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_pack_sf_binary.md)
  [`gx_pack_sf_binary()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_pack_sf_binary.md)
  :

  Pack an sf, sfc, or data.frame object into a GEXP binary buffer
  (`gl_pack_sf_binary`)

- [`gl_pack_raster_binary()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_pack_raster_binary.md)
  [`gx_pack_raster_binary()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_pack_raster_binary.md)
  :

  Pack a terra SpatRaster or matrix into a GEXR Float32 binary buffer
  (`gl_pack_raster_binary`)

- [`gl_spatial_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_spatial_index.md)
  [`gx_spatial_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_spatial_index.md)
  :

  Build an in-memory C++ spatial index for fast viewport queries
  (`gl_spatial_index`)

- [`gl_query_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_query_index.md)
  [`gx_query_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_query_index.md)
  :

  Query a spatial index for features intersecting a bounding box
  (`gl_query_index`)

- [`gl_duckdb_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_duckdb_index.md)
  [`gx_duckdb_index()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_duckdb_index.md)
  :

  Create a DuckDB Out-of-Core Spatial Query Index (`gl_duckdb_index`)

- [`gl_serve_start()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_serve_start.md)
  [`gx_serve_start()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_serve_start.md)
  :

  Start the local zero-copy binary & tile server (`gl_serve_start`)

- [`gl_serve_stop()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_serve_stop.md)
  [`gx_serve_stop()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_serve_stop.md)
  :

  Stop the local zero-copy binary server (`gl_serve_stop`)

- [`gl_server_status()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_server_status.md)
  [`gx_server_status()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_server_status.md)
  :

  Query status of the local binary server and registered buffers
  (`gl_server_status`)

- [`gl_benchmark_data()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_benchmark_data.md)
  [`gx_benchmark_data()`](https://meztez.github.io/glmap/reference/gl_benchmark_data.md)
  :

  Generate Synthetic Geospatial Benchmark Datasets (`gl_benchmark_data`)
